short.zh: 把两个数汇进一个元件
short.en: Merge two numbers in one component

t.zh: 汇合器把几根线送来的数加起来，「—」不参与。
t.en: A Merger adds up the numbers its wires bring; “—” is left out.

goal.zh: 起点已经写好 1。让机器人算出每个路口的路线数：上面 + 左边。
goal.en: The start already holds 1. Have the robot work out the routes to every crossing: up + left.

how.zh: 把「上面」和「左边」都接进一个汇合器，再接到「本格」。
how.en: Wire “up” and “left” into one Merger, then the Merger to “this cell”.

showcase.zh: 第一次往板上放元件：元件放在输入和输出之间，几条来路收成一个数
showcase.en: the first part placed on a board: it sits between the inputs and the output and gathers several ways in into one number

body.zh: 你只接了三根线，机器人就把整座城市填满了。
body.en: You drew three wires and the robot filled in the whole city.

hints.zh: 两个输入都接进同一个汇合器。
hints.en: Wire both inputs into the same Merger.
